text:
Meeting: TechFest 2026 — Core Committee Sync
Date: August 15, 2026
Attendees: Rhea (Fest Coordinator), Aditya (Logistics), Sana (Sponsorship), Farhan (Tech/Web), Ishaan (Design)

Rhea: Let's start with venue booking. Aditya, did the auditorium get confirmed for the main day?
Aditya: Yes, the main auditorium is confirmed for October 4th. I signed the booking form yesterday. Still pending is the outdoor ground for the gaming zone — the sports office hasn't responded yet.
Rhea: Can you follow up with them by this Thursday?
Aditya: Sure, I'll chase the sports office by Thursday, August 20th.

Rhea: Sponsorship update, Sana?
Sana: TechNova Solutions confirmed as title sponsor, contract signed. They're giving 2 lakhs plus swag for participants. On the second sponsor, CodeCraft, they're still reviewing internally — no word yet on amount or timeline.
Rhea: Okay, keep nudging them but no fixed deadline since it's out of our hands. Can you at least send the sponsorship deck to two more potential backup sponsors this week?
Sana: Yes, I'll send the deck to two backup sponsors by Friday, August 21st.

Rhea: Website and registration, Farhan?
Farhan: Registration form is live, we've had about 300 signups so far. The payment gateway for the paid workshops is still not integrated — I was waiting on Sana to confirm final workshop pricing before wiring that up.
Sana: Right, sorry, I still need to finalize pricing with the workshop leads. I don't have a date for that yet, it depends on their material costs.
Rhea: Okay, Farhan, once pricing comes in can you turn around the payment integration in two days?
Farhan: Yeah, two days once I get the numbers, so it's blocked on Sana for now.
Rhea: Separately, Farhan, can you fix the mobile view of the schedule page? A few people complained it's unreadable on phones.
Farhan: I'll fix the mobile schedule layout by Wednesday, August 19th.

Rhea: Design and print materials, Ishaan?
Ishaan: Posters and banners are designed and approved. ID cards template is done too. Still working on the stage backdrop design — that one's taking longer since we're waiting on the final list of sponsor logos to place on it.
Rhea: No firm date on the backdrop then, since it depends on Sana's sponsor list. Ishaan, can you at least get the ID cards printed by early next week so registration desk has them ready?
Ishaan: I'll get ID cards printed by Monday, August 24th.

Aditya: One risk to flag — we still don't have a confirmed headcount for volunteer coordinators, and without the outdoor ground booking we can't finalize the gaming zone layout either.
Rhea: Noted, both are blockers we need to resolve before next week's meeting. Let's also make sure Farhan and Sana sync separately on workshop pricing since that's holding up two things now — the payment gateway and possibly some sponsor commitments.

Rhea: Alright, good progress. Recap of open risks: outdoor ground booking still pending, workshop pricing blocking two workstreams, and second sponsor CodeCraft still undecided. Let's regroup same time next week.
